ref_en: Open to randomly obtain one piece of <Highlight>level 60</> <Highlight>Competition-oriented</> orange or gold-quality equipment, Beyonder materials, Aggregation Factors, or bound Sol. There is a certain chance to obtain 1 Gray Fog Crystal (used to upgrade level 64 or higher competition brooches to Mythical quality). You can obtain at most 3 per week; unobtained amounts can be accumulated to the following week.

ref_en: The one-click support currently used in this setup is a beginner setup and cannot be overwritten.

ref_en: There is currently no declaration of war or you are not in a declaration of war scene!

source_cn: 当前穿戴穿戴穿戴装备
徘徊不去的英灵 真实造物主的眷属 凝视命运的眼睛
ref_en: The lingering heroic spirit, the kin of the True Creator, the eye that gazes at fate.

source_cn: 忽视目标{*d,F1690001,mDefReduce}+{*.1f**,F1690001,mDefDivi}的魔法防御，降低目标魔法防御对魔法攻击基础值的减免。（百分比效果后于数值效果生效）\n减免后的攻击基础值存在<Highlight>75%</>的上限和<Highlight>20%</>的下限，提升的破防超出上阈值或未到下阈值时，无法提升增伤能力。\n实际效果和阈值取决于攻防双方<Highlight>等级</>、与对方<Highlight>魔法防御</>属性的对抗结算。
ref_en: Ignores {*d,F1690001,mDefReduce}+{*.1f**,F1690001,mDefDivi} of the target's magic defense, reducing the target's magic defense reduction on the base magic Attack value. (Percentage effects take effect after numerical effects) \nThe reduced base Attack value has an upper limit of <Highlight>75%</> and a lower limit of <Highlight>20%</>. If the increased Armor Break exceeds the upper threshold or fails to reach the lower threshold, the damage boost capability cannot be improved. \nThe actual effect and thresholds depend on the confrontation calculation between the attacker and defender's <Highlight>Level</>, and the opponent's <Highlight>Magic Defense</> attribute.

source_cn: 您处于世界灾厄玩法中，无法进行该操作
ref_en: You are in the World Calamity gameplay and cannot perform this operation.

source_cn: 我也完全理解你即将做出的决定。但在这之前，我想邀请你再闻闻雏菊的芬芳。
ref_en: I also fully understand the decision you are about to make. But before that, I would like to invite you to smell the fragrance of the daisies again.

source_cn: 我喊她的名字，没人答应。我……我透过玻璃门往里看，我看见星星，星星爆炸，喷出好多血。
ref_en: I called her name, but no one answered. I... I looked inside through the glass door and saw stars—stars exploding and spraying out so much blood.

source_cn: 战士-姿态切换-巨剑到双刀
ref_en: Warrior - Stance Switch - Greatsword to Dual Blades
So, did you confirm it in the end?

source_cn: 摆放指定类型的家具数量
ref_en: Place specified number of furniture of specified type

source_cn: 收藏结果未保存，是否退出？
ref_en: The collection results have not been saved. Do you want to exit?

source_cn: 攻击玩家和建筑类型的敌方时，提高自身的攻击。
ref_en: When attacking player and building type enemies, increases own Attack.
Is it still useful? \n (Used by Amon boss).

source_cn: 杰斯？你怎么不说话？杰斯？
ref_en: Jack? Why aren't you saying anything? Jack?

source_cn: 染色基础素材，可用于时装染色，以及解锁染色槽位。
ref_en: Basic dyeing material, can be used for fashion dyeing and unlocking dye slots.

source_cn: 注意及时驱散暗光效果！
ref_en: Be sure to dispel the dark light effect in time!

source_cn: 牌局很长，长得就像那个连输了十五把的男人流泻而出的悲伤。
ref_en: The card game is long, as long as the sadness pouring out of that man who lost fifteen games in a row.
Cut the vines with the axe

source_cn: 监听关闭阅读界面  对象播放指定对白内容
ref_en: Listen for reading interface closure, object plays specified dialogue content

source_cn: 目之所及，帽檐之下，是非被揉碎后重新拼贴。
ref_en: As far as the eye can see, beneath the brim, right and wrong are crumbled and reassembled.

source_cn: 真是一出伟大的戏剧，这两个小时让我仿佛度过了一生。
ref_en: What a great play. These two hours felt as if I had lived a whole lifetime.

source_cn: 真是个可怜的男人。不过，他说的，是真的吗？
ref_en: What a pathetic man. However, is what he said true?

source_cn: 真的吗？对，我好像有点印象……他是说了那家餐厅的名字吗？他应该说了……！
ref_en: Really? Yes, I seem to have a vague memory... Did he say the name of that restaurant? He must have said it...!

source_cn: 瞭望塔，始终为你照亮航路！
ref_en: The Watchtower will always illuminate the path for you!

source_cn: 羔羊肉怎么样？相当鲜美，非常适合用来做嫩豌豆炖羔羊肉这道菜！
ref_en: How's the lamb? It's quite delicious, very suitable for making the dish of tender peas stewed with lamb!

source_cn: 能四处游历做自己喜欢的事，真帅呀，是不是？
ref_en: Being able to travel around and do what you love is really cool, isn't it?

source_cn: 至于其他的，我只能说，他对廷根的值夜者小队有非常深厚的感情。
ref_en: As for the rest, I can only say that he has very deep feelings for the Tingen Nighthawk squad.

source_cn: 舞会餐车出生标记buff，监听自己如果被服务员上了buff，则开始干活
ref_en: Ball Food Cart Spawn Mark Buff, listen if waiter buffs self, then start working

source_cn: 这不是针对您本人，只是有旁人靠近会影响仪式场域的纯净……啊，我是说，是研究性质的仪式。
ref_en: This is not directed at you personally, it's just that having others nearby will affect the purity of the ritual field... Ah, I mean, it's a research-based ritual.

source_cn: 这样厉害的武器，我们还有很多！诚挚为您介绍……
ref_en: We have many more weapons as powerful as this! Allow me to sincerely introduce...

source_cn: 这煎肉闻起来真好，有一种让人怀念的味道……也许是因为香草吧。我们这就尝尝！
ref_en: This seared meat smells so good, it has a nostalgic scent... maybe it's the herbs. Let's try it!

source_cn: 通关移动推挤等基础能力，将目标
ref_en: Through basic abilities like moving and pushing, move the target

source_cn: 队长，对不起把你吵醒了……我们应该更小心些的。
ref_en: Captain, I'm sorry for waking you... We should have been more careful.

source_cn: 驾驭蒸汽车疾驰于街巷，乘风破浪冲过险滩，借灵性之跃腾空飞越——追逐风暴之主的脚步，赢取独属于你的荣耀与馈赠。
ref_en: Drive a steam car to speed through the streets, ride the wind and waves to rush through dangerous shoals, and use the Leap of Spirituality to soar through the air—chase the footsteps of the Lord of Storms and win the glory and gifts that belong only to you.

source_cn: 黑暗持续了两千年。直到伟大的愚者，回应了白银城居民的祈祷。
ref_en: The darkness lasted for two thousand years. Until the great Fool responded to the prayers of the residents of the City of Silver.

source_cn: <HighLight>%s</>紫气东来，%s重塑获得恩赐<HighLight>%s</>，真是羡煞旁人！
ref_en: <HighLight>%s</>, the purple aura comes from the east, %s has reshaped and obtained the blessing <HighLight>%s</>; truly, others are envious!

source_cn: <HighLight>卡牌能量</>达到5点时才可释放。消耗5点<HighLight>卡牌能量</>，在2.7秒内持续向锁定目标发射卡牌，对目标及其小范围内敌方造成12次spellfielddisc(*id)点物理伤害并<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">打断</>敌方怪物，施法过程中可以释放其他技能和移动。\n只要本技能处于可释放状态，<HighLight>终结技能</>就不会切换至<HighLight>命运愚弄</>或<HighLight>灵性爆发</>，但它们依然可通过收集<HighLight>命运黄牌</>或<HighLight>灵性蓝牌</>解锁，并在本技能释放后立刻进入可用状态。
ref_en: Can only be released when <HighLight>Card Energy</> reaches 5 points. Consume 5 points of <HighLight>Card Energy</> to continuously fire cards at the locked target for 2.7 seconds, dealing spellfielddisc(*id) physical damage 12 times to the target and enemies in a small area, and <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">interrupting</> enemy monsters. You can release other skills and move while casting. \nAs long as this skill is available, the <HighLight>Finisher Skill</> will not switch to <HighLight>Fooling of Fate</> or <HighLight>Spirituality Burst</>, but they can still be unlocked by collecting <HighLight>Fooling of Fate Yellow Cards</> or <HighLight>Spirituality Blue Cards</> and will become available immediately after this skill is cast.

source_cn: <P_Heart>（精神状态稍微有点差，毕竟她刚才经历了那么多事情……看来蒙特利没有骗我。）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart> (Her mental state is a bit poor; after all, she just went through so much... It seems Monterey didn't lie to me.) </>

source_cn: <player>玩家名称七个字</>开启“别野派对”，邀请各位非凡者参加！
ref_en: <player>Player Name Seven Chars</> has started a "Villa Party", inviting all Beyonders to attend!

source_cn: {{先生，你今天和提拉米苏一样深邃！|女士，你今天和草莓小蛋糕一样可爱！}}
ref_en: { Mr. {, you are as profound as a tiramisu today! | Ms. }, you are as cute as a strawberry cupcake today! }

source_cn: ……我明白了，这十几年，你隐瞒了真实身份，和最重要的事——
ref_en: …I understand. For these past ten-plus years, you have hidden your true identity and the most important thing—

source_cn: 我很享受“通识者”这个身份。\n　　一件奇怪的事情，当我以“通识者”自居，做的事情都符合它的定位时，那些让我几乎发疯的耳语安静了不少，我时不时爆发的脾气也得到了控制，并想起了日记这件事情。​\n　　这就是那位神秘的查拉图先生对我提过的“扮演”吗？这或许是解决魔药隐患的关键。​
ref_en: I really enjoy the identity of a "Savant." \n A strange thing: when I consider myself a "Savant" and do things that fit its positioning, those whispers that almost drove me crazy quieted down quite a bit, my temper, which would erupt from time to time, was also brought under control, and I remembered the matter of the diary. \n Is this the "Acting" that the mysterious Mr. Zaratul mentioned to me? This might be the key to solving the hidden dangers of the potion.

source_cn: 不好意思，我不知道你们的关系。你怎么样？
ref_en: Sorry, I didn't know about your relationship. Are you alright?

source_cn: 为什么得是我遇见这种事？我就这么倒霉吗？
ref_en: Why does it have to be me who encounters this kind of thing? Am I really that unlucky?

source_cn: 他因为溺水记忆混乱，心智也不够成熟，我们失去了沟通的基础。塔罗学院已经在暗中观察保护他，准备找机会和他建立联系。
ref_en: Because of his near-drowning, his memories are in chaos and his mental state is not mature enough; we have lost the foundation for communication. The Tarot Academy has already been secretly observing and protecting him, preparing to find an opportunity to establish contact.

source_cn: 伟大的占卜家，请问我该去哪？
ref_en: Great Seer, may I ask where I should go?

source_cn: 你们只能向我许愿，祈求怜悯！
ref_en: You can only make wishes to me and beg for mercy!

source_cn: 你成功中断了秩序之网的力量，被困住的大剑掉了下来。现在村内可以自由携带任何大剑了。
ref_en: You have successfully interrupted the power of the Web of Order, and the trapped greatsword has fallen. Now, any greatsword can be freely carried within the village.

source_cn: 你是说那个像偷渡上来的？叫什么来着……
ref_en: You mean the one who looked like he snuck on board? What was his name again...

source_cn: 俱乐部图书馆中积累的每一本典籍，都是前辈非凡者以生命换来的经验结晶；而那些在命运转折处伸出援手的同道，则是比任何魔药都更可靠的依靠。 知识与同伴，是诡秘世界中最稳固的庇护。\n<Talent>投骰时，获得俱乐部成员协助重投的概率增加10%</>。
ref_en: Every classic book accumulated in the club library is the crystallization of experience exchanged for the lives of predecessor Beyonders; and those fellow travelers who lend a helping hand at the turning points of fate are more reliable than any potion. Knowledge and companions are the most stable shelter in the mysterious world. \n<Talent>When rolling dice, the probability of obtaining assistance from club members for a reroll increases by 10%</>.

source_cn: 克莱恩：（看起来他会把钱包还回去……）
ref_en: Klein: (It looks like he's going to return the wallet...)

source_cn: 午夜梦回获得启示，就在解救人质的房间对面，出现了对那本《安提格努斯家族笔记》的感应，发现关键人物瑞尔比伯,但已无踪影，只能请求圣堂派人护送“2-049号封印物”过来......发现关键人物瑞尔比伯,但已无踪影，只能请求圣堂派人护送“2-049号封印物”过来......发现关键人物瑞尔比伯,但已无踪影，只能请求圣堂派人护送“2-049号封印物”过来......
ref_en: Received a revelation in a midnight dream. Right across from the room where the hostages were rescued, I sensed the presence of that "Antigonus Family Notes". I discovered the key figure, Ray Bieber, but he had already vanished. I had no choice but to request the Cathedral to send someone to escort "Sealed Artifact 2-049" over... source_cn: 卡门，你试过带着活物穿墙吗？
ref_en: Carmen, have you tried walking through a wall while carrying a living creature?

source_cn: 哇，小戴莉你的发言真是越来越……个性了。
ref_en: Wow, little Daly, your remarks are becoming more and more... individualistic.
Ah, found him. Shaman is here.

source_cn: 噢，原来是一个观众向琳达热情地招手。嘿，支持偶像没问题，可别影响比赛啊。
ref_en: Oh, it turns out a spectator was waving enthusiastically at Linda. Hey, supporting your idol is fine, but don't disrupt the match.

source_cn: 在战场上绝不轻易退却，勇于面对对手。
ref_en: Never retreat easily on the battlefield and be brave to face your opponents.
The Clown is studying Sealed Artifact 2-049!

source_cn: 廷根老实人！邻里大新闻！
ref_en: Tingen Honest Reporter! Neighborhood big news!

source_cn: 开启窥秘之眼检查房间
ref_en: Activate Eyes of Mystery Prying to check the room

source_cn: 您的邀约已被应允，%s的历史投影正穿越时光而来。静候片刻，一场独属于二人的漫步即将启程。
ref_en: Your invitation has been accepted, and the historical projection of %s is traveling through time. Wait a moment; a stroll belonging only to the two of you is about to begin.

source_cn: 我们还一起战斗过，算是朋友？
ref_en: We also fought together, does that count as friends?

source_cn: 我就那样吃了一整天。那天后我不再想要醋栗，不再想要任何东西。
ref_en: I ate like that for an entire day. After that day, I no longer wanted gooseberries, nor did I want anything else.

source_cn: 我干嘛要去杀人呢？虽然我很想离开，但也不能杀人啊。
ref_en: Why would I want to kill someone? Even though I really want to leave, I can't just kill people.

source_cn: 我说……快点吧，我总感觉这地方有人在看我们。
ref_en: I say... hurry up, I keep feeling like someone is watching us here.

source_cn: 我赌三个苏勒！囤囤的宝藏藏在最粗的树后面！
ref_en: I bet three soli! The hoarder's treasure is hidden behind the thickest tree!

source_cn: 我这次一定能进入上流社会！
ref_en: I will definitely enter high society this time!
Derrick Full Bright - 35m Large Circle Area

source_cn: 暗紫色如深夜的战马，身披厚重银色战甲，如幽冥使者在人间巡游。
ref_en: Dark purple like a midnight warhorse, clad in heavy silver armor, roaming the world like a messenger from the underworld.

source_cn: 果子都去哪里了？……等等，好像有人在尖叫？
ref_en: Where did the fruits go? ...Wait, is someone screaming?

source_cn: 查看NPC的作者和最后编辑者
ref_en: View NPC author and last editor.

source_cn: 武力大提升，学识小提升
ref_en: Strength Greatly Increased, Knowledge Slightly Increased

source_cn: 死亡咏叹补充-芬恩撞上托马斯神父
ref_en: Death's Requiem Supplement - Finn Bumps into Father Thomas

source_cn: 沿这条路直走就是查尼斯门 希望邓恩队长别等急了
ref_en: Walk straight along this road to reach Chanis Gate. I hope Captain Dunn isn't waiting impatiently.

source_cn: 知识教会的人追得很紧，我的时间不够了，你能帮帮我吗？
ref_en: The people from the Church of Knowledge are in hot pursuit, and I'm running out of time. Can you help me?
Vortex of Strife will begin in %s seconds.
The King who rules the sky

source_cn: 警官您辛苦了！我这种小本生意人，就指望治安良好混口饭吃，有事您随时吩咐！
ref_en: Thank you for your hard work, Officer! A small businessman like me relies on good public order to make a living. If you need anything, just let me know!

source_cn: 诚实的回答，下次我会把问题限定在长大以后。
ref_en: An honest answer. Next time I will limit the question to after you grew up.

source_cn: 说实话，我也有点搞不清状况。
ref_en: To be honest, I'm a bit confused about the situation myself.

source_cn: 谢谢您！要不是您，我简直不知道还会发生什么！
ref_en: Thank you! If it weren't for you, I don't know what would have happened!

source_cn: 费内波特玉米 | 面粉 | 烟熏猪颈肉 | 欧芹
ref_en: Feynapotter Corn | Flour | Smoked Pork Neck | Parsley

ref_en: Wasn't that your favorite play? Now you're blaming me?

source_cn:
很久没有再写日记了，在这个黑暗的陵寝中，在疯狂与污染交织的缝隙里，清醒是困难的。
        回首这一生，我从一个普通的穿越者，变成了改变世界的大帝。我发明了蒸汽机，建立了共和国，征服了海洋，书写了法律……但我也失去了太多——我的故乡，我的平凡，我的孩子们的爱，还有……我自己。
        黄涛，你还记得吗？那个在地球上熬夜看小说、打游戏、抱怨工作的普通青年？那个想念妈妈做的红烧肉、想念和朋友撸串吹牛的普通人？有时候我觉得自己好像做了一个很长的梦，梦里我成为了无所不能的大帝，但醒来时，我只想要一张回家的车票。
        但我知道，我回不去了。即使成为真神，即使拥有改变一切的力量，我也回不去那个有网络、有外卖、有平凡幸福的家了。
        所以，我只能把这里当成我的家，把这个世界当成我另一个的家乡。
        我留下了蒸汽机，留下了法律，留下了航道，留下了故事和诗歌……我希望这个世界能变得更好，希望后来的人能少受一些苦，希望他们能记住——曾经有一个人，从很远的地方来，把这里当成了自己的家。
        贝尔纳黛，如果你能看到这份日记，我想告诉你：爸爸不是一个好皇帝，也不是一个好父亲。我做出了太多错误的选择，伤害了太多我爱的人。但如果重来一次，我还是会选择保护你，哪怕你看不到，哪怕你恨我。
        还有夏尔、博诺瓦……我的孩子们。愿你们能在这个我亲手改变过的世界里，找到属于自己的幸福。
        我也许又要沉眠了。我不知道，哪一次道别，会成为真正的告别。但不要悲伤。我，罗塞尔·古斯塔夫，黄涛——即使死亡，也要死得轰轰烈烈！况且……谁说我真的死了呢？
        只要还有人记得我的名字，只要我的故事还在流传，只要这个世界还在使用我留下的发明和律法……我就从未真正离开。等着吧，总有一天，你们会听到那句话——
        因蒂斯的子民们，你们的皇帝，回来了！
ref_en:
It has been a long time since I wrote in my diary. In this dark mausoleum, in the gaps where madness and corruption intertwine, clarity is difficult. 
 Looking back on this life, I went from an ordinary transmigrator to an Emperor who changed the world. I invented the steam engine, established the Republic, conquered the oceans, wrote the laws... but I also lost too much—my hometown, my ordinariness, the love of my children, and... myself. 
 Huang Tao, do you remember? That ordinary young man on Earth who stayed up late reading novels, playing games, and complaining about work? That ordinary person who missed the braised pork made by his mom and missed hanging out with friends to eat skewers and brag? Sometimes I feel like I had a very long dream, in which I became an omnipotent Emperor, but when I wake up, I only want a ticket home. 
 But I know, I can't go back. Even if I become a True God, even if I possess the power to change everything, I can't go back to that home with the internet, takeout, and ordinary happiness. 
 So, I can only treat this place as my home and this world as my other hometown. 
 I left behind the steam engine, the laws, the shipping routes, the stories, and the poems... I hope this world can become better, I hope later generations can suffer less, and I hope they can remember—there was once a person who came from very far away and treated this place as his own home. 
 Bernadette, if you can see this diary, I want to tell you: Dad is not a good Emperor, nor is he a good father. I made too many wrong choices and hurt too many people I loved. But if I could do it all over again, I would still choose to protect you, even if you can't see it, even if you hate me. 
 And Charles, Bernadette... my children. May you find your own happiness in this world that I changed with my own hands. 
 I might have to sleep again. I don't know which farewell will be the real one. But don't be sad. I, Roselle Gustav, Huang Tao—even if I die, I will die with a bang! Besides... who said I really died? 
 As long as there is still someone who remembers my name, as long as my story is still being told, as long as this world is still using the inventions and laws I left behind... I have never truly left. Just wait, one day, you will hear that sentence— 
 Citizens of Intis, your Emperor has returned!

1.榜单数据将每分钟自动更新一次，确保信息及时。
2.部分榜单支持按途径筛选，您可点击顶部的 “全部途径” 按钮进行切换。
3.部分榜单支持地区排名查看，点击上方的对应地区页签即可切换。
4.点击榜单底部的自身信息行，可快速定位并跳转到您当前所在的排名位置。
5.点击其他非凡者的信息行，可查看对方形象；点击其头像，则可进一步查看该非凡者的个人名片。
6.各段位达到天使之王，且排名总榜前30或途径前5，即可获得星辰之主段位，持续14天，段位分变化后若满足条件则刷新时长为14天。
7.副本排行榜中，只有同服玩家组队通关副本，才会计入排行榜。
ref_en:
1. Leaderboard data will be updated automatically every minute to ensure information is timely.
2. Some leaderboards support filtering by Pathway; you can click the "All Pathways" button at the top to switch.
3. Some leaderboards support viewing regional rankings; click the corresponding regional tab above to switch.
4. Click your own information row at the bottom of the leaderboard to quickly locate and jump to your current ranking position.
5. Click on other Beyonders' information rows to view their appearance; click on their avatar to further view that Beyonder's personal profile.
6. Once you reach the King of Angels rank and are in the top 30 of the overall leaderboard or top 5 of a Pathway, you will obtain the Lord of Stars rank, which lasts for 14 days. If you still meet the conditions after your rank points change, the duration will be refreshed to 14 days.
7. In the Dungeon leaderboard, only dungeons cleared by a team of players from the same server will be counted.

source_cn: <Hide stylename="Transparent" id="#161_R">……</>这几天，我的心脏总跳的很快，这是一种不安。从镇外的工厂下班回家，我不再敢走古堡那条路。镇子上的气氛很怪，每个人的情绪都很坏，告示板说，有一户人家被灭门了，他们说是流窜的通缉犯做的，但直觉告诉我，没那么简单。照理来说，按照我的探索精神，我应该去和亡魂、和灵去探究，但是，知道这个消息的那个瞬间，我居然在想，我会不会就是下一个？\n\n  这不是好的预兆，我想这是一个提示。
ref_en: <Hide stylename="Transparent" id="#161_R">...</>These past few days, my heart has been beating very fast; it's a sense of unease. After getting off work at the factory outside the town, I no longer dare to take the road by the old castle. The atmosphere in the town is very strange, everyone's mood is very bad. The notice board says that a family was wiped out; they say it was done by a fugitive on the run, but my intuition tells me it's not that simple. Logically speaking, with my spirit of exploration, I should go and investigate with the ghosts and spirits, but the moment I heard this news, I was actually thinking, could I be the next one? \n\n This is not a good omen; I think this is a hint.

source_cn: 他被马车撞了，紧急就医去了。
ref_en: He was hit by a carriage and went to the doctor for an emergency.

source_cn: 你可问对了人了，我家世代都从事传统草药行业。有病没病，人们喝点草药合剂总是没问题的。
ref_en: You've asked the right person. My family has been in the traditional herb industry for generations. Whether sick or not, people drinking some herbal concoctions is always fine.

source_cn: 你很擅长用<P_Yellow>幽默</>为自己辩解。
ref_en: You are very good at using <P_Yellow>humor</> to defend yourself.

ref_en: You have not learned the lesson of the collapse and are building a new cage in the ruins. History is repeating itself; beware of repeating the same mistakes.

使用后获得<Highlight>旌旗的赞颂发型</>\n也可兑换为<Highlight>1</>张神眷牌

source_cn: 卷边的纸牌，已经有些旧了。
ref_en: Frayed playing cards, already a bit old.

source_cn: 参与副本<Highlight>五月庄园·花园（普通）</>，击败<Highlight>先祖铠甲</>后，有概率获得下列装备。
ref_en: Participate in the dungeon <Highlight>May Manor · Garden (Normal)</>. After defeating <Highlight>Ancestor Armor</>, there is a chance to obtain the following equipment.

source_cn: 又在宣扬他那套赢学……真是受够了。
ref_en: Preaching his winning philosophy again... I'm really sick of it.

source_cn: 又脏又破！……唉，找来的佣人总是逃走，有的还会偷家里的珠宝。
ref_en: It's dirty and broken! ...Sigh, the servants I hire always run away, and some even steal the family's jewelry.

source_cn: 呵呵，有段时间，我认为自己只是普通的北大陆学者，直到找回了记忆。
ref_en: Haha, for a time, I considered myself just an ordinary scholar from the Northern Continent, until I recovered my memories.

source_cn: 咳咳……没事，就是早上起来痰里有点黑渣滓。
ref_en: Cough, cough... it's nothing, just some black residue in my phlegm when I wake up in the morning.

source_cn: 唉，早知道不和那个药剂师打赌说能找到能在东区雾霾里活过一个月的花了，这下不知道要赔几枚新淘到的古老铜币了。
ref_en: Sigh, I shouldn't have bet with that apothecary that I could find a flower that could live for a month in the East District smog. Now I don't know how many newly acquired ancient copper coins I'll have to pay out.

ref_en: Chamber of Commerce Dividend I effective, Chamber of Commerce ticket quantity {1}->{2}

ref_en: Four glasses of Southwell, worth fighting for you!

source_cn: 如果他能停止以那副高高在上的好市民姿态对我的成员说教，就更好了。
ref_en: It would be even better if he could stop lecturing my members with that high-and-mighty "good citizen" attitude.
Security company... You used to be in security?

ref_en: After completing a certain number of movements, the Bard may invite you to a mysterious location to watch a story from the past.

我们的哭声在旋转的轮轴间回响……
ref_en: Our cries echo between the rotating wheels...

source_cn: 我只是随便一说，你还当真了。
ref_en: I was just saying that, you actually took it seriously.

source_cn: 房主不可给自己分配身份
ref_en: The room owner cannot assign an identity to themselves.

ref_en: Open to randomly obtain 1 <Highlight>non-tradable</> gold Extraordinary material with 1-2 affixes.

source_cn: 撕碎新生的祭品，换取你们的自由吧！
ref_en: Tear apart the newborn sacrifice and trade it for your freedom!

ref_en: Traveler, what is sealed here by wind and snow cannot be taken by brute force—if you wish to open it, you must first pass the Knight's trial.

source_cn: 既然线索的思路是对的……那破解故事的关键或许就是书上的两个仪式之一。
ref_en: Since the line of reasoning for the clues is correct... then the key to cracking the story might be one of the two rituals in the book.

ref_en: Are you here to practice because you're too nervous?

ref_en: Cannot return to the castle for now; please try again later.

ref_en: Sometimes I think, if it weren't for his guidance, I might have lost control or died in some Extraordinary incident long ago.

被拉拽到星象仪者身前时，迅速<Highlight>远离</>星象仪者。

ref_en: Filmer coffee is produced near the Star Plateau in the Paz Valley. It is dense and light, with a long-lasting aftertaste; it is a good choice.

ref_en: Let's go, Klein. Let's head to the ballroom and play some games.

ref_en: I got these from the rich, impressive, right?

ref_en: Club Fund Consumption </> Building upgrades consume club funds and require a certain amount of time. Each building has corresponding level-up effects, and other buildings cannot exceed the level of the Council Hall. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Time Restrictions </> Building upgrade caps are gradually unlocked based on server time. The daily limits for each level are: Level 3: After 8:00 AM on the 7th day of the server Level 4: After 8:00 AM on the 14th day of the server Level 5: After 8:00 AM on the 21st day of the server Level 6: After 8:00 AM on the 30th day of the server Level 7: After 8:00 AM on the 45th day of the server Level 8: After 8:00 AM on the 60th day of the server

source_cn: ……我明白的，值夜者的死亡率一直都很高。
ref_en: ...I understand, the mortality rate of Nighthawks has always been very high.

source_cn: 一个关于“现在”和“过去”的游戏，猜猜哪边能通向“未来”？
ref_en: A game about the 'present' and the 'past'. Guess which side leads to the 'future'?

source_cn: 亚巴顿释放禁忌咒语，在场上召唤大量附带邪恶能量的陨星从天而降。若陨星坠落至地面则会爆炸，对全场玩家造成伤害并附加<Disable>邪恶印记</>效果，若陨星在落地前被玩家接住，则只对该名玩家造成伤害和附加<Disable>邪恶印记</>效果。
ref_en: Abaddon releases a forbidden spell, summoning a large number of meteors infused with evil energy to fall from the sky. If a meteor hits the ground, it will explode, dealing damage to all players and applying an <Disable>Evil Mark</> effect. If a player catches a meteor before it hits the ground, it will only deal damage to that player and apply an <Disable>Evil Mark</> effect.

source_cn: 他们太疯狂，我实在追不上他们。
ref_en: They are too crazy, I really can't keep up with them.

source_cn: 他因为愤怒已经失去理智了！得赶紧拦住他！
ref_en: He has lost his mind due to anger! Must stop him quickly!

source_cn: 伊妮德消失，玩家往前走。
但他们是不可能查到任何痕迹的。
ref_en: But they will never find any traces.

source_cn: 你说什么？咳咳，好大的烟！有人在烧火？！去房间里看看！
ref_en: What did you say? Cough, cough—there's so much smoke! Is someone lighting a fire?! Go check the room!

ref_en: Holy Ointment is a special item used to <Highlight>record affixes</>. The affixes it records do not take effect directly and can only be <Highlight>used to apply to the random affixes of equipment</>. \nHoly Ointment also has item grades; high-grade ointment can be used on low-grade equipment, but the affix values will only partially take effect after application. Stone brick for the little girl to stand on

source_cn: 怨恨与执念似乎消失了。
ref_en: The resentment and obsession seem to have vanished.

source_cn: 我不知道它之前是什么味道，但这一道非常美味！
ref_en: I don't know what it tasted like before, but this is delicious!

source_cn: 我从廷根市过来。拉姆德小镇倒是个热闹的地方。
ref_en: I came from Tingen. Lamud Town is quite a lively place.

source_cn: 我第一次经历的时候，以为自己要死了。
ref_en: When I experienced it for the first time, I thought I was going to die.

source_cn: 战争可以在几分钟内夺去几百名战友的生命……可更残酷的是，我甚至永远无法替他们报仇，替他们完成心愿。
ref_en: War can take the lives of hundreds of comrades in a few minutes... but what's more cruel is that I can never even avenge them or fulfill their wishes for them.

ref_en: All enemies gain Stigma at the start of combat; when enemies die, allies gain short-term Fanaticism.

ref_en: A specified number of bullets are summoned simultaneously and fired sequentially at specified intervals; bullets not successfully fired when leaving the interval are automatically recycled.

ref_en: Seeing that you're a new face, if you buy a book now, I'll pay out of my own pocket to treat you to a black beer.

ref_en: Although your power exceeds our imagination, there are always areas in the world that you do not understand or are not good at.

source_cn: 这没什么。我在文法学校读书时，母亲重病去世了。也就是在那时，我收到了父亲的来信，让我继承了贝克兰德的财产。
ref_en: It's nothing. When I was studying at grammar school, my mother passed away from a serious illness. That was when I received a letter from my father, asking me to inherit the property in Backlund.

source_cn:
伦纳德·米切尔，是个诗人的名字。
——虽然他本人并不会写诗。
一个不会写诗的诗人，听起来就充满了戏剧性，这也符合他曾经对自己的期待——故事的主角，特殊的命运，传奇的人生。
起初一切的确按照这个方向发展：他顺利成为非凡者，掌握一些“秘密”，结识靠谱的同伴，无数次守护廷根。历史的车轮滚滚向前，从未因他的散漫而有所薄待，这大概就是主角的标配吧，一点过人的天赋，一群过命的朋友，一段不凡的旅程……

多么平淡、美好、无聊的日子啊。
直到邪神降临，无情地击碎了一切。

伦纳德·米切尔，并非命运的眷儿。
只是个弱小而不自知的凡人。

但纵使是凡人也不会停止前进的步伐，如同星星虽然微小，却始终在努力发光。
他收起散漫，走上了一条沉默的成长之路。
他成为了红手套。
他成为了“星星”。
他完成了复仇。
——但他依旧不会写诗。

“那又有什么关系呢？我很满意我现在的样子。
“一个不会写诗的午夜诗人，才是我灵魂中最重要的部分。
“这样，不管在非凡路上走多久，不管离疯狂和失控多近……
“只要还拥有这些，我就始终记得自己属于哪里。
“疯狂和痛苦，就永远不会伤害我。”
ref_en:
Leonard Mitchell is a poet's name.
 — though he himself cannot write poetry.
 A poet who cannot write poetry sounds full of drama, which fits what he once expected of himself—the protagonist of a story, a special fate, a legendary life.
 At first, everything did indeed develop in that direction: he successfully became a Beyonder, mastered some "secrets," met reliable companions, and guarded Tingen countless times. The wheels of history rolled forward, never slighting him because of his indolence; this was probably the standard equipment for a protagonist: a bit of exceptional talent, a group of friends who would die for each other, and an extraordinary journey...

 What dull, beautiful, boring days they were.
 Until the evil god's descent, which ruthlessly shattered everything.

 Leonard Mitchell was not a child of fate.
 Just a weak mortal who didn't know it.

 But even a mortal would not stop moving forward, just as stars, though tiny, are always trying to shine.
 He put away his indolence and embarked on a silent path of growth.
 He became a Red Glove.
 He became "The Star."
 He completed his revenge.
 — But he still cannot write poetry.

 "And what does that matter? I am satisfied with who I am now.
 "A midnight poet who cannot write poetry is the most important part of my soul.
 "This way, no matter how long I walk on the Beyonder path, no matter how close I get to madness and loss of control...
 "As long as I still possess these, I will always remember where I belong.
 "Madness and pain will never be able to hurt me."

一条血统不那么纯正的金毛大狗，一个购买猎狐犬的赠品。她的世界一度很简单：阳光、庭院、饼干，和那个总是笑着蹲下来摸她脑袋的小女孩。
直到那瓶魔药被意外打翻。
命运从不征求谁的同意。当非凡特性渗入她的皮毛、血液、骨骼，以及那颗懵懂跳动的心脏时，苏茜拥有了第一缕“意识”。她能听懂更多了——那些话语之下的沉默，笑容背后的疲惫，还有奥黛丽在深夜独处时、连她自己都未必察觉的孤独。
她从不掩饰自己是一条狗。这是她的骄傲。狗能嗅出谎言，而人类只能听见语言；狗能用尾巴告诉你所有真心话，而人类学会了用微笑筑墙。当她趴在霍尔家的地毯上，守望着来往的客人时，她看见的比任何一位宾客都多——那些虚伪的殷勤、算计的眼神、隐藏在赞美之下的嫉妒。
她曾思考过：作为一条拥有了智慧的狗，你觉得自己更像人，还是更像狗？
她摇了摇尾巴，得出了自己的答案。
“我更像我自己。一条学会了说话却依然喜欢追尾巴的金毛犬，一条读完了心理学中的人性却依然相信善良的非凡生物。不必成为人，依旧可以用一双与众不同的眼睛，为所有孤独的心灵，带来一片温暖的安宁。”

“毕竟，我只是一条狗。而这，恰恰是我最擅长的事。”
ref_en:
A golden retriever of not-so-pure blood, a freebie from buying a foxhound. Her world was once very simple: sunshine, the courtyard, biscuits, and the little girl who always smiled and squatted down to pat her head. 
 Until that bottle of potion was accidentally knocked over. 
 Fate never asks for anyone's consent. When the Beyonder characteristic seeped into her fur, blood, bones, and that innocently beating heart, Susie gained her first glimmer of "consciousness." She could understand more—the silence beneath those words, the exhaustion behind the smiles, and the loneliness Audrey felt when alone late at night, which perhaps even Audrey herself hadn't noticed. 
 She never hides the fact that she is a dog. This is her pride. Dogs can sniff out lies, while humans can only hear language; dogs can use their tails to tell you all their true feelings, while humans have learned to build walls with smiles. When she lay on the Hall family's carpet, watching the guests come and go, she saw more than any guest—the hypocritical obsequiousness, the calculating eyes, and the jealousy hidden beneath praise. 
 She once pondered: As a dog with wisdom, do you feel more like a human or more like a dog? 
 She wagged her tail and reached her own answer. 
 "I am more like myself. A golden retriever who learned to speak but still likes to chase her tail, a Beyonder creature who has read about human nature in psychology books but still believes in kindness. There is no need to become human; one can still use a pair of unique eyes to bring a piece of warm peace to all lonely hearts." 
 
 "After all, I am just a dog. And that is exactly what I am best at."
Can't get down, can you! Idiot!
Main Story 1-5: Shocking Discovery of a Corpse in the Residence

<InvHighlight>2号和3号子弹</>是真的。

欲念使者增加了<InvHighlight>真弹的数量</>，使第一次选择命中真弹的概率达到<InvHighlight>三分之二</>。

当一颗真弹被排除后，重新选择的胜率反而降至<InvHighlight>二分之一</>。因此，<InvHighlight>坚持原本的选择</>更为有利。

概率只能揭示更有利的选择，并不能决定最终结果。若实际结果与判断不符，也只是<InvHighlight>运气造成的偶然</>。
ref_en:
<InvHighlight>Bullet No. 2 and No. 3</> are real. 

The Messenger of Desire increased the <InvHighlight>number of real bullets</>, making the probability of hitting a real bullet on the first choice reach <InvHighlight>two-thirds</>. 

When a real bullet is excluded, the win rate of choosing again actually drops to <InvHighlight>one-half</>. Therefore, <InvHighlight>sticking to the original choice</> is more advantageous. 

Probability can only reveal the more advantageous choice; it cannot determine the final result. If the actual result does not match the judgment, it is merely <InvHighlight>an accident caused by luck</>.

source_cn: 你与弗莱队长离开安全屋，突破重重阻拦赶往中央广场，见到绯红满月降临，献祭仪式开始，异变市民化为洪流被吞噬。在神秘女士贝尔纳黛的指引下，你们进入各个隐藏空间收集罗塞尔的残存意志——故乡、女儿、时代，大帝的残存意志苏醒，一击打破污染屏障，你们趁势摧毁绝望魔镜，打断了献祭，伦纳德在停滞的时间中救下众人，再一次拯救廷根。然而调查报告揭示，月亮仆从的势力未被根除，五月庄园的邪神子嗣仍在孕育，真正的危机尚未解除……
ref_en: You and Captain Frye leave the safe house, break through numerous obstacles, and rush to Central Plaza, where you see the crimson full moon descend and the Sacrifice Ritual begin, with mutated citizens turning into a torrent and being swallowed. Under the guidance of the mysterious lady Bernadette, you enter various hidden spaces to collect Roselle's residual will—hometown, daughter, era. The Emperor's residual will awakens, breaking the corruption barrier with one strike. You take the opportunity to destroy the Magic Mirror of Despair, interrupting the sacrifice. Leonard saves everyone in the stagnant time, saving Tingen once again. However, the investigation report reveals that the forces of the Moon Servant have not been eradicated, the offspring of the evil god in May Manor is still gestating, and the true crisis has not yet been resolved...

ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Covenant Level, Breakthrough and Rewards】</>
After joining a Covenant, you start at Level 1 by default. Obtain Action Points through Covenant gameplay; once the points are sufficient, you can increase your level.

<Assistant_Title2>Breakthrough Quest: </>
For some levels, you must complete a breakthrough quest after reaching the Action Point cap. Action Points will continue to accumulate while the breakthrough quest is incomplete. Once completed, the level can continue to increase.

<Assistant_Title2>Reward Collection: </>
Rewards can be collected directly in the level rewards interface.

<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Search: </>{SendAnswer:[Covenant Action Points and Weekly Cap]|1276}

These corrupted marionettes are attempting to establish a secret channel to the Fool's spirit through memory items related to Klein. Once successful, the Mother Goddess will have the ability to affect the Fool's spirit, affecting the entire Southern Continent. The Church needs someone to enter the former Utopia town, clear the out-of-control marionettes, investigate the remaining memories, and finally cut off the source of the corruption.

……
　　不知从什么时候起，“隐匿贤者”疑似活化。
　　祂是无处不在的灵数，是知识本身，祂疯狂地追逐着每一个摩斯苦修会的成员，甚至是每一个“窥秘人”，这种现象被称为“知识逐人”。
　　当海潮般的知识灌注而来时，受灌输者要么放开心灵防线，接受“隐匿贤者”的改造，要么凭毅力支撑。
　　当知识灌注冲破毅力防线的那一刻，便会引发失控。
　　但，我想，祂的灌输，未必没有用处。
ref_en:
... 
 I do not know when it started, but the "Hidden Sage" is suspected to have become active. 
 It is the ubiquitous spiritual number, the knowledge itself. It madly pursues every member of the Moses Ascetic Order, and even every "Mystery Pryer." This phenomenon is known as "Knowledge Pursuit." 
 When the tidal wave of knowledge pours in, the recipient must either open their mental defenses and accept the transformation by the "Hidden Sage," or support themselves with willpower. 
 The moment the infusion of knowledge breaks through the defense of willpower, it triggers a loss of control. 
 However, I think Its infusion may not be without its uses.

You like selling overpriced tickets, do you?

ref_en: If you like, we can go in and take a look. I think the owner would be happy to see a beautiful lady trying on jewelry.

source_cn: 平凡到一定程度，也算一种非凡？

ref_en: The flower stall beneath the flower-covered walkway is such a cozy little shop, filled with the fresh scent of plants.

source_cn: 很像，就是觉得……有点太像了？
ref_en: You do, it's just that I feel... a bit too much like one?

source_cn: 怎么，欺负聋哑画家？小心我揍你！
ref_en: What, bullying a deaf-mute painter? Watch out, or I'll beat you up!

source_cn: 您如果愿意，可以留下地址，我闲暇时会登门拜访。
ref_en: If you are willing, you can leave your address, and I will visit when I have free time.

source_cn: 我、我看到一双手救了我，但最后又突然笑着松开，我看不清他的样子，然后整个人开始急速坠落。
ref_en: I, I saw a pair of hands save me, but finally, they suddenly let go with a smile. I couldn't see his face clearly, and then my whole body started falling rapidly.

source_cn: 我不需要变成人来证明自己的价值，也不需要假装自己只是一条普通的狗来逃避责任。
ref_en: I don't need to become a human to prove my value, nor do I need to pretend to be just an ordinary dog to shirk responsibility.

source_cn: 是的，和家人团聚……是我们在这个世界活下去的意义。
ref_en: Yes, reuniting with family... is the meaning of our existence in this world.

ref_en: Julian, don't just stand there watching the fun, are you coming in the next round?

source_cn: 父亲？我呸，他从来没把我当亲儿子看过！看他只培养老三埃德加的样子就知道了！
ref_en: Father? Pfft, he never treated me like his own son! Just look at how he only groomed the third one, Edgar, and you'll know!

source_cn: 第二天，我想去预支下个月的薪水，看到老板在用牛排喂它的狗。我上前想跟老板说话，老板的狗却以为我要抢它的牛排，把我咬了……
ref_en: The next day, I wanted to ask for an advance on next month's salary, and I saw my boss feeding his dog steak. I went up to talk to him, but the dog thought I was trying to steal its steak and bit me...

source_cn: 细心、耐心和恒心缺一不可，那谁要上台呢？
ref_en: Carefulness, patience, and perseverance are all essential. So, who is going on stage?

ref_en: Bonnie: Don't worry, I won't kill him. I need an audience... to witness your transformation.

获得<HighLight>10%伤害加深</>。<HighLight>层叠印记</>的叠加上限提升至<HighLight>3</>层，附加印记所需的<HighLight>足迹</>降低至<HighLight>2</>层。

source_cn:
教会传来消息，封印物2-327“看见我”失窃。占卜显示线索指向黑伍德庄园。
　　黑伍德男爵今晚举办舞会。我们需要一个善于观察的人混入舞会调查——你是序列9“观众”，没有比你更合适的人选。
　　你的身份已安排妥当：贝克兰德来的新兴商人，听闻庄园有投资机会，受邀赴宴。
　　记住，观众不登台。
　　观察，不要打草惊蛇。
ref_en:
The Church has received news that the Sealed Artifact 2-327 "See Me" has been stolen. Divination shows that the clues point to Heywood Manor.
	Baron Heywood is hosting a Ball tonight. We need someone good at observation to sneak into the Ball to investigate—you are a Sequence 9 "Spectator", and there is no one more suitable than you.
	Your identity has been arranged: an emerging businessman from Backlund who heard about investment opportunities at the manor and was invited to the banquet.
	Remember, the Spectator does not take the stage.
	Observe, and do not alert the enemy.

source_cn:
为给诸位更体面的购物环境，本店将
　　于即日起暂停营业六周，全店翻修。

　✦  新增进口原木打造专柜
　✦  全店换装吊灯

ref_en:
To provide a more respectable shopping environment for all, this store will 
　　suspend operations for six weeks starting today for a full renovation.

　✦  Added display counters crafted from imported logs
　✦  Installed new chandeliers throughout the store
　✦  Expanded the second-floor VIP lounge

　　The reopening date has yet to be determined; for details, please follow the "Backlund Post."
　　Present the newspaper on the day of your visit to pay nine-tenths of the regular price.

source_cn: 五月庄园_子嗣守护_1目标_Buff84008607

亲爱的非凡者：
    “势力战”已经拉开帷幕，通过对您俱乐部的综合评判，星星高原战场静候您的到来。
    请及时在以战养战-势力-高原战界面查看赛程赛制，准时报名参与。
    参与高原战，即可收获人脉和秘偶抽取道具、苏勒分红、战场称号等馈赠。
    愿您在四皇注视下主宰战场，稍后再见！
ref_en:
Dear Beyonder: 
    The "Faction War" has begun. Based on a comprehensive evaluation of your Club, the Star Plateau battlefield awaits your arrival. 
    Please check the schedule and rules in the War-by-War - Faction - Plateau War interface in time and sign up to participate on time. 
    Participate in the Plateau War to receive gifts such as connections, marionette drawing items, Sol dividends, and battlefield titles. 
    May you dominate the battlefield under the gaze of the Four Emperors, see you later!

source_cn: 比赛规则</> 赛场使用<Highlight>玩家真实属性</>，<Highlight>装备、封印物、秘偶、人脉、非凡天赋系统效果</>均可生效。玩家将以战队形式进行比赛，每个战队内同途径玩家最多为两名。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>报名规则</> 比赛报名开启后，玩家即可组建或加入战队，战队成员<Highlight>达到5名</>后即可报名。 开启报名至锁定报名期间，战队队长可自由调整战队成员，成员也可自由离开战队，已报名战队若成员变动导致成员数量小于5名后将自动取消报名。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>锁定规则</> 锁定报名期间，已报名战队可以进入准备场地，未报名战队仍可以进行报名操作，玩家也可以加入战队，但不可以主动离开或队长请离战队，已报名战队将不允许取消报名。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>对战规则</> 比赛正式开始后，玩家需要<Highlight>停留在准备场地</>以保证正常进入比赛，擅自离开准备场地将导致无法正常参加比赛。 小组赛阶段，每轮随机匹配对手进行单局比赛，共进行六轮，根据胜场数选出16支队伍晋级，胜场数相同会根据<Highlight>荣耀值决出晋级者（荣耀值参考击杀数、战斗时长）</>。 小组赛结束后进入助力阶段，淘汰赛开始前根据<Highlight>助力值和荣耀值总和</>确定淘汰赛位次，淘汰赛开始后仍可进行助力，但不再影响淘汰赛位次。 淘汰赛阶段将进行<Highlight>三局两胜</>来确定胜负，决赛将进行<Highlight>五局三胜</>决出冠军！
ref_en: Match Rules </> The arena uses <Highlight> player's real attributes </>, and the effects of <Highlight> equipment, Sealed Artifacts, marionettes, connections, and Beyonder talent systems </> are all effective. Players will compete as a team, with a maximum of two players of the same pathway per team. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Registration Rules </> Once match registration opens, players can form or join a team. Once a team <Highlight> reaches 5 members </>, they can register. From the opening of registration until it is locked, the team leader can freely adjust members, and members can freely leave. If a registered team's member count falls below 5 due to changes, registration will be automatically canceled. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Locking Rules </> During the registration lock period, registered teams can enter the preparation area. Unregistered teams can still register, and players can join teams, but they cannot leave or be removed by the leader. Registered teams cannot cancel their registration. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Battle Rules </> After the match officially begins, players must <Highlight> stay in the preparation area </> to ensure they enter the match normally; leaving the preparation area without authorization will result in being unable to participate. In the group stage, opponents are randomly matched for a single-game match. There are six rounds in total, and 16 teams are selected to advance based on wins. If wins are tied, <Highlight> Glory Value (based on kills and combat duration) </> will determine the advancer. After the group stage, the support phase begins. Before the knockout stage, the knockout bracket is determined based on the <Highlight> sum of support value and Glory Value </>. Support can still be given after the knockout stage begins, but it will no longer affect the bracket. The knockout stage will use a <Highlight> best-of-three </> format to determine the winner, and the final will use a <Highlight> best-of-five </> format to determine the champion!

source_cn: <InvDefault_HW>银雾森林迎来了今年的第一场雪，东边的雾气也越发浓厚，掉落了不少羽毛的戴莉在窝里冻得直发抖。枝头小小的巢穴无法抵御寒冷，顶上抖落的一坨雪将巢穴砸落下去，戴莉还没来得及发出叫声，就发现自己被温暖的灰色皮毛包裹——它落在了一只灰麋鹿的头顶。</>\n\n　　<InvDefault_HW>“我察觉到这里有动物需要帮助，是你吗？”那只灰麋鹿这么说道。</>
ref_en: <InvDefault_HW> The Silver Mist Forest welcomed the first snow of the year, and the mist in the east grew even thicker. Daly, having lost many feathers, shivered in its nest from the cold. The tiny nest on the branch could not withstand the chill, and a clump of snow shaken from above knocked the nest down. Before Daly could even let out a cry, it found itself wrapped in warm, grey fur—it had landed on the head of a grey moose. </>\n\n　　<InvDefault_HW> "I sensed that an animal here needed help. Is it you?" the grey moose said. </>

source_cn:
奥黛丽当即开动脑筋，边思索边说道：
　　“您是‘愚者’先生，来自塔罗牌，那作为一个定期的、长期的、隐秘的‘聚会’，称号得尽量一致，嗯，我也从塔罗牌里挑吧。”
　　她的口吻慢慢变得愉快：
　　“决定了，我的称号是，‘正义’！”
　　这是塔罗牌二十二张主牌之一。

　　——第一卷《小丑》第七章 代号
ref_en:
Audrey immediately put her mind to work, thinking as she said: 
　　"You are Mr. Fool, from the Tarot cards. As a regular, long-term, and secret 'gathering,' the titles should be as consistent as possible. Hmm, I'll pick from the Tarot cards too." 
　　Her tone gradually became cheerful: 
　　"Decided, my title is, 'Justice'!" 
　　This is one of the twenty-two Major Arcana cards. 

　　——Volume 1: Clown, Chapter 7: Codename

"Magician" Fors quietly took a breath and said:
 "I would like to purchase the stomach of a Spirit Eater and 20ml of blood from a Deep Sea Marlin, paying with gold pounds."
 I still have 430 pounds, I can afford one... she encouraged herself silently.
 As for where the money for the other item would come from, she had no idea for the moment.
 This is one of the main reasons that restricts the advancement of many Beyonders... People really shouldn't try to consume beyond their own means. If it weren't for completely getting rid of the influence of the full moon's whispers and becoming a "Faceless," having relatively rich extraordinary means, I wouldn't even consider advancement, or even touch this circle. source_cn:
金毛大狗似乎被花朵的香味迷乱了嗅觉，并未注意到身后的主人，它张开嘴巴，发出吊嗓子般的“啊啊啊”“呀呀呀”声音。
　　紧接着，它让周围的空气振动，响起生涩不够圆润的单词：
　　“你好。”
　　“你好吗？”
　　……
　　奥黛丽的嘴巴一点点张开，完全忘记了优雅淑女该具备的礼仪，她完全不敢相信自己看到的这一幕场景和听到的僵硬声音。
　　她猛地站起，脱口而出道：
　　“苏茜，你会说话？你什么时候会说话了？”
　　金毛大狗吓得跳了起来，转身面对了主人。
　　它慌乱而快速地摇起尾巴，嘴部张合几次后才震荡了周围的空气道：
　　“我……”
　　“我不知道该怎么解释，毕竟我只是一条狗。”
　　听到这句话，奥黛丽一时竟无言以对。

　　——第一卷《小丑》第一百一十二章 阿兹克的解释
ref_en:
The golden retriever seemed to have its sense of smell dazed by the fragrance of the flowers and did not notice its owner behind it. It opened its mouth and made "ah-ah-ah" and "ya-ya-ya" sounds like someone warming up their voice. 
 Immediately after, it caused the surrounding air to vibrate, sounding out stiff and unpolished words: 
 "Hello." 
 "How are you?" 
 ... 
 Audrey's mouth opened bit by bit, completely forgetting the etiquette a graceful lady should possess. She could not believe the scene she was seeing and the stiff voice she was hearing. 
 She stood up abruptly and blurted out: 
 "Susie, you can talk? Since when could you talk?" 
 The golden retriever jumped up in fright and turned to face its owner. 
 It wagged its tail in a flustered and rapid manner, and only after opening and closing its mouth several times did it vibrate the surrounding air to say: 
 "I..." 
 "I don't know how to explain it, after all, I am just a dog." 
 Hearing this, Audrey was left speechless for a moment. 
 
 —— Volume 1 "Clown", Chapter 112, Azik's Explanation

ref_en:
<Title>Divine Selection Seats</>
During the strategic server faction battle phase, Divine Selection Seats are composed of <Highlight>weekly ranking settlement seats</> and <Highlight>final ranking settlement seats</>. Every week, seats will be distributed based on the weekly ranking of each faction on the strategic server and the Club's ranking within its faction; the higher the ranking, the more seats can be obtained. Upon strategic server settlement, final ranking settlement seats will be distributed to Clubs within the faction based on the final ranking of each faction. The Divine Selection Seats obtained by a Club are distributed internally by the Club management. 

<Title>Reward Content</>
Divine Selection rewards include <Highlight>strategic server exclusive cosmetic rewards, cultivation items, Sol, bound Gold Pounds</>, etc. 

<Title>Limited-Time Divine Descent</>
Upon strategic server settlement, the <Highlight>President, Vice President, and Directors</> of the four Clubs in the faction ranked first overall can obtain the limited-time 30-day Divine Descent outfit <Highlight>Song of Iron and Blood</>. 

<Title>Reward Distribution</>
Rewards will be distributed uniformly <Highlight>after the strategic server Victor's Declaration ceremony ends</>.

source_cn:
当你展开这封信笺时，芬芳的气息已将你包裹。这并非偶然，而是必然的命运——你被选中了。

　　在贝克兰德雾气弥漫的街头，在廷根宁静的小巷深处，有这样一群人：他们追求极致的美丽，拥抱命运的无常，在灾厄中翩翩起舞。

　　我们是春夜舞会。

　　我们侍奉的是不幸与美丽的源头，是将灾难化作艺术的存在。在祂的庇护下，我们明晰了一个真理：

　　真正的美，诞生于毁灭与重生之间。

　　若你愿意加入我们，请前往"珠宝店"门口右侧。

　　记住，我们不接受怯懦者，不欢迎虚伪者。唯有敢于凝视深渊，敢于拥抱真实的人，才配得上这场永不落幕的舞会。

　　期待你的到来。
ref_en:
As you unfold this letter, a fragrant scent already envelops you. This is no coincidence, but an inevitable fate—you have been chosen. 

　　In the fog-drenched streets of Backlund, deep within the quiet alleys of Tingen, there exists a group of people: they pursue ultimate beauty, embrace the impermanence of fate, and dance gracefully amidst disaster. 

　　We are the Spring Night Ball. 

　　We serve the source of misfortune and beauty, the existence that transforms catastrophe into art. Under His shelter, we have realized a truth: 

　　True beauty is born between destruction and rebirth. 

　　If you are willing to join us, please head to the right side of the "Jewelry Store" entrance. 

　　Remember, we do not accept the cowardly, nor do we welcome the hypocritical. Only those who dare to gaze into the abyss and dare to embrace the truth are worthy of this ball that never ends. 

　　Looking forward to your arrival.

<Assistant_Title2>家族属性加成：</>在副本内与一定数量的同家族成员组队可以获得额外的<Assistant_Property1>复活次数加成</>和<Assistant_Property1>属性补足加成</>，离开家族后有<Assistant_Red>24小时</>的生效冷却期。
<Assistant_Title2>副本奖励加成：</>在特定副本内，与一定数量的同家族成员组队通关时，可以获得<Assistant_Property1>额外奖励</>，离开家族后有<Assistant_Red>24小时</>的生效冷却期。
<Assistant_Title2>家族商店奖励：</>完成家族任务可以获得<Assistant_Property1>默契值</>与<Assistant_Property1>同行纹章</>奖励，满足一定家族等级以及加入时长，可在<Assistant_System>同行商店</>兑换<Assistant_Property1>珍贵奖励</>。
<Assistant_Title2>家族称号：</>加入家族自动获得<Assistant_Property1>家族称号</>，首席可在家族详情处修改家族名称，名称修改具有<Assistant_Red>30天</>的冷却期，修改成功后家族称号会同步修改。
<Assistant_Title2>家族展台：</>随家族等级提升，将解锁可用于家族展台的专属场景，具体规则可查看<Assistant_Property1>家族-展台规则</>。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[家族]|665}，{SendAnswer:[家族-契约方式]|666}，{SendAnswer:[家族-等级规则]|668}，{SendAnswer:[家族-展台规则]|669}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Family-Reward Explanation】</>
<Assistant_Title2> Family Attribute Bonuses: </>Teaming up with a certain number of Family members in a dungeon grants extra <Assistant_Property1>Resurrection count bonuses</> and <Assistant_Property1>attribute supplementation bonuses</>. There is a <Assistant_Red>24-hour</> cooldown period after leaving a Family.
<Assistant_Title2> Dungeon Reward Bonuses: </>Clearing specific dungeons while teamed up with a certain number of Family members grants <Assistant_Property1>extra rewards</>. There is a <Assistant_Red>24-hour</> cooldown period after leaving a Family.
<Assistant_Title2> Family Shop Rewards: </>Completing Family quests grants <Assistant_Property1>Rapport</> and <Assistant_Property1>Companion Emblem</> rewards. Upon meeting certain Family level and membership duration requirements, you can exchange them for <Assistant_System>precious rewards</> in the <Assistant_Property1>Companion Shop</>.
<Assistant_Title2> Family Title: </>Joining a Family automatically grants a <Assistant_Property1>Family Title</>. The Chief can modify the Family name in Family Details. Name changes have a <Assistant_Red>30-day</> cooldown, and the Family title will be updated accordingly upon a successful change.
<Assistant_Title2> Family Display Stand: </>As the Family level increases, exclusive scenes for the Family display stand will be unlocked. For specific rules, please check <Assistant_Property1>Family-Display Stand Rules</>.
<Assistant_Title3> Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Family]|665}, {SendAnswer:[Family-Contract Methods]|666}, {SendAnswer:[Family-Level Rules]|668}, {SendAnswer:[Family-Display Stand Rules]|669}

source_cn: 你在雪山深处听见微弱的呼救声。一个名叫布雷登的年轻士兵求你救救被困的战友——他们和大部队走散，缺衣少食，已经撑不了多久。你带着他寻找物资、追踪营地，却发现事情逐渐变得古怪——积雪厚得不正常，营地的物品破败不堪。真相浮出水面——布雷登原是漂泊雪原数年的灵，只为寻找解救战友的办法。记忆的碎片一段段苏醒，他忆起战友们鲜活的面容，可战争早已结束，他怔在原地：为何而死，又为何而等？执念终了，他如风雪般消散。愿神的国度里，他们能真正重逢。
ref_en: You hear a faint cry for help deep in the snowy mountains. A young soldier named Braden begs you to save his trapped comrades—they were separated from the main force, lacking food and clothing, and cannot hold on much longer. You take him to find supplies and track the camp, but things gradually become strange—the snow is abnormally thick, and the items in the camp are dilapidated. The truth surfaces—Braden was originally a spirit who had been wandering the snowy plains for years, just to find a way to save his comrades. Fragments of memory awaken one by one, and he recalls the vivid faces of his comrades, but the war has long ended. He stands there, stunned: why did he die, and why did he wait? The obsession ends, and he dissipates like the wind and snow. May they truly reunite in the kingdom of God.

source_cn:
%s:
      我听闻你与星象仪者遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对星象仪者的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302114">星象仪者</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard that you encountered a bitter battle with the Astrolabe User. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of time past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the tips for facing the Astrolabe User: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302114">Astrolabe User</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what makes people stop is often not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing new adventures, and I think next time, the news I hear will be better. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me that might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

ref_en: [Loen Business News] A certain station's iron ore acquisition price soars! Urgent need for supply!

source_cn: 不对！那是褐星，旁边的那颗才是蓝星。我敢说莱利叔叔和你说话时喝太多朗齐酒了。
ref_en: Wrong! That's the Brown Star, the one next to it is the Blue Star. I bet Uncle Riley drank too much Ronchi wine when he talked to you.

source_cn: 人类想要成为非凡者，并在非凡之路上持续走下去，只能依靠魔药。
ref_en: Humans who want to become Beyonders and continue on the path of the extraordinary can only rely on potions.

source_cn: 今天祷告的时候，有几个孩子跳起来，嘴里叫着“无聊”“听不懂”。
ref_en: During prayer today, a few children jumped up, shouting 'boring' and 'I don't understand'.

source_cn: 但你看墙上——已经挂着六枚了。他每刻一枚，墙上就多一枚。总有一天，墙上会挂满星币。
ref_en: But look at the wall—there are already six hanging there. Every time he carves one, there's one more on the wall. One day, the wall will be covered in pentacles.

source_cn: 佛尔思召唤一道闪电，电击目标敌方造成一定伤害，若目标为怪物，则造成的伤害提升75%。
ref_en: Fors summons a bolt of lightning to strike the target enemy, dealing damage. If the target is a monster, damage is increased by 75%.
Why do you have something going on every day?

source_cn: 你看，前面这些还挺正常——“帮忙到邮局领取家人寄的书信”……
ref_en: Look, the ones at the beginning are quite normal—'Help pick up letters sent by family at the post office'...

source_cn: 使用扮演技能“赞颂烈阳”
ref_en: Use the acting skill "Praise the Sun"

source_cn: 先生，现在可以应聘哪个岗位？
ref_en: Sir, which positions are hiring right now?

source_cn: 击杀隐藏在意识深处的怪物
ref_en: Kill the monsters hidden in the depths of the consciousness

source_cn: 原木构建的柱体，朴实的形制很是自然。
ref_en: A column body built from raw wood, with a plain design that is very natural.

source_cn: 受你召唤的隐者牌，以正位之姿显现。真正的答案往往来自内心……抱歉，我看不到更多了。
ref_en: The Hermit card you summoned appears upright. The true answer often comes from within... Sorry, I cannot see more.

source_cn: 受到奥黛丽心理暗示，达到2层后将被操控。
ref_en: Affected by Audrey's Psychological Suggestion; will be controlled after reaching 2 stacks.
Is this the only small piece of bread...

source_cn: 召唤星之虫幻化的秘偶来释放梦境分析，创建半径6米的领域，持续治疗领域范围内友方，每秒回复友方*d点生命，持续<HighLight>6</>秒。
ref_en: Summon a marionette transformed from a Star Worm to release Dream Analysis, creating a domain with a 6-meter radius that continuously heals allies within the domain, restoring *d Health per second for <HighLight>6</> seconds.

source_cn: 可用于在封印物界面提升非凡知识等级。
ref_en: Can be used in the Sealed Artifact interface to increase Beyonder knowledge level.

source_cn: 哦……那些黑色药汁太苦了……
ref_en: Oh... those black medicinal juices are too bitter...

source_cn: 回廷根查案子 和 迎接这位新员工
ref_en: Back in Tingen to investigate a case and to welcome this new employee.
Sit down and enjoy the food

source_cn: 大哥哥/大姐姐，你也和我一起玩好不好？我保证，把你藏在我最喜欢的地方，和乌达放在一起！
ref_en: Big brother/Big sister, won't you play with me too? I promise to hide you in my favorite place, right next to Wuda!
